name: Alnam no Kiba: Juuzoku Juunishinto Densetsu
original_name: アルナムの牙 獣族十二神徒伝説
source:
Kenbu is a young warrior who trains in the art of shape-shifting - his people possess the ability to turn into beasts. One day, his home village is attacked by a hideous spider-like monster. Kenbu's best friend and mentor dies protecting him. The young hero kills the monster, but soon thereafter has to leave the village and find out who or what was behind that attack. Kenbu encounters other heroes, and together they must stop the evil that is threatening the entire world.

Alnam no Kiba is a remake of the PC Engine RPG of the same title from two years prior. The same general plot is present, but the entire game has been reworked from a traditional Japanese-style RPG into a Japanese-style adventure or visual novel game. The player controls Kenbu as he explores various locales, speaking to other characters, and sometimes ending up with them tagging along with him.

Much of the original game's assets have been reused, but there are also some new graphics and music as well as some differences in the story, creating a very different alternate version of the game. As a bonus, there is also a gallery of fan art with commentary included on the disc.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/43108/alnam-no-kiba-juzoku-junishinto-densetsu/]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
肯布是一位年轻的战士，接受变形艺术训练——他的人民拥有变成野兽的能力。有一天，他的家乡遭到一只可怕的蜘蛛状怪物的袭击。肯布最好的朋友兼导师为保护他而死。年轻的英雄杀死了怪物，但不久之后就必须离开村庄，找出这次袭击的幕后黑手。肯布遇到了其他英雄，他们必须一起阻止威胁整个世界的邪恶。

Alnam no Kiba是两年前同名PC引擎RPG的重制版。总体情节相同，但整个游戏已从传统的日式角色扮演游戏重新设计为日式冒险或视觉小说游戏。玩家控制Kenbu探索不同的地点，与其他角色交谈，有时最终让他们跟随他。

原版游戏的大部分资源都被重复使用，但也有一些新的图形和音乐以及故事中的一些差异，创造了一个非常不同的游戏替代版本。作为奖励，光盘上还设有一个粉丝艺术画廊，其中包含评论。

[来自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/43108/alnam-no-kiba-juzoku-junishinto-densetsu/]Moby Games[/url]]
